overview: Markets: Sensex sank 1,280 points intraday to a 2026 low as oil prices and rate-hike fears spooked investors.
Big story: Iran is reviewing a US ceasefire counterproposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after months of war.

items.headline: Iran reviews US ceasefire counterproposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Iran received a US counterproposal for a ceasefire and phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz after months of war, even as commercial vessels were hit by projectiles there. Oil prices stayed elevated on the uncertainty, a risk Indian refiners and the rupee are watching closely.

items.headline: Last US troops complete withdrawal from Iraq
items.summary: The final American troops and equipment left Erbil air base, ending a 12-year military campaign against ISIS and a two-decade US presence in Iraq. The pullout, agreed with Baghdad in 2024, comes as Kurdish officials worry about losing US air defences amid regional tensions.

items.headline: FlyDubai pilot stabbed captain, tried to crash Israel-bound jet
items.summary: A pilot stabbed the captain of a Dubai-Tel Aviv Flydubai flight carrying about 170 people and tried to crash it; passengers and crew overpowered him and the plane landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Investigators are probing whether the attack was a planned terrorist act.

items.headline: Gaza recovers remains of 105 Palestinians from Gaza City rubble
items.summary: Civil defence teams pulled the remains of 105 people from a destroyed residential block after a 17-day search, among the largest such recoveries since the war began. Ceasefire violations continue, with Israel still controlling nearly 70% of Gaza nearly a year into the truce.

items.headline: India's Cabinet clears Rs 2.79 lakh crore package for energy, farms
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 2.79 lakh crore package spanning a Green Energy Corridor to evacuate 135 GW of renewable power, a Rabi MSP hike under PM DHARA, and a Delhi traffic overhaul. It signals continued big-ticket infrastructure and farm-support spending ahead of the festive season.

items.headline: Xi Jinping reaffirms opposition to Taiwan independence at National Day
items.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping called for hitting full-year economic targets while reiterating firm opposition to Taiwan independence and "external interference" at a National Day reception. He urged deeper cross-strait exchanges alongside a crackdown on separatist forces, underscoring Beijing's dual economic and security messaging.

items.headline: France unveils austerity 2027 budget with frozen wages, new taxes
items.summary: PM Sebastien Lecornu presented a belt-tightening budget with roughly 43 billion euros in new measures, including frozen public-sector wages and VAT and income-tax rises, aiming to cut France's deficit to 5% of GDP from 5.4%. The plan faces a tough fight in a fragmented parliament.

items.headline: Iran says it foiled bomb plot near Tehran, killed six
items.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard said security forces killed six members of a group planning a bomb attack near Tehran, recovering explosives during the raid. The announcement comes as Iran weighs a US ceasefire proposal, highlighting continued internal security operations even as diplomacy over the war proceeds.

items.headline: UK and France end 'one in, one out' migrant returns deal
items.summary: Britain and France ended their year-old pilot scheme to return Channel migrants, under which about 1,500 people were sent back to France in exchange for vetted asylum seekers. Only about 4% of small-boat arrivals were returned, and Paris now wants an EU-wide replacement.

items.headline: South Africa summons US ambassador a third time in months
items.summary: Pretoria's foreign ministry called in US Ambassador Leo Brent Bozell III again over "undiplomatic conduct," the third such summons since February. Relations are strained by President Trump's repeated claims that white South Africans face systemic persecution, which Pretoria rejects as mischaracterising its redress policies.

items.headline: Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro tied ahead of Brazil's election
items.summary: Brazil holds its first-round presidential vote on October 4, with incumbent Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the banned former president, running neck-and-neck in the polls. A runoff looks likely if neither candidate tops 50% of valid votes.

items.headline: Bangkok floods deepen financial strain on debt-laden households
items.summary: Thailand's worst flooding in 15 years, which has killed dozens and submerged large parts of the capital, is wiping out incomes for small businesses and workers already burdened by high debt. The disaster is straining government finances in an already fragile economy.

items.headline: Pakistan weighs imposing emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
items.summary: Islamabad is "seriously considering" invoking emergency powers in PTI-led Khyber Pakhtunkhwa over its worsening security situation and a planned march on the capital demanding Imran Khan's release. The ruling coalition has warned of governor's rule if the provincial government does not call off the march.

items.headline: Russian strike on Kyiv's Academy of Sciences kills two
items.summary: Russia pounded Kyiv with drones and missiles, hitting the Ukrainian Academy of Sciences and killing two people, as Moscow pressed its aerial campaign on energy and civilian infrastructure. Air defences intercepted most of an overnight barrage of nearly 190 drones.

items.headline: Dangote breaks ground on $16 billion Kenya oil refinery
items.summary: Africa's richest man Aliko Dangote began construction on a $16 billion refinery in Kenya, joined by the presidents of Kenya, Ethiopia and Uganda, aiming to replicate the success of his Nigerian plant. The project targets fuel self-sufficiency amid a global energy crunch.

items.headline: Heavy fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region kills 52 civilians
items.summary: At least 52 civilians were killed over three days of fighting around Alamata as government troops took the town and may be advancing on Mekelle. Clashes have spread to neighbouring Amhara and Afar, with over 700 wounded admitted to MSF-backed hospitals.

items.headline: Monthly report warns India can't take growth momentum for granted
items.summary: A government economic report flagged that despite Q1 FY27 GDP growth of 7.8%, the highest first-quarter reading in the current series, India cannot be complacent given global trade disruptions and uneven external demand. It projects Q2 growth easing to around 7.3%.

items.headline: Congress flags 'problematic' functioning of JPC on FCRA bill
items.summary: Congress general secretary KC Venugopal wrote to Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla criticising the Joint Parliamentary Committee reviewing the FCRA Amendment Bill, seeking wider stakeholder consultation. Opposition MPs want the committee's October 12 meeting postponed by at least four weeks to allow fuller submissions.

items.headline: Supreme Court refuses priority hearing for ex-judicial officer's plea
items.summary: The Supreme Court declined to fast-track a former judicial officer's challenge to her termination, holding that all citizens have an equal right to access justice and that individual priority hearings are unfair to other litigants waiting in queue. The underlying case continues in the high court.

items.headline: Karnataka cancels 16 drug licences over spurious-medicine racket
items.summary: Karnataka's food and drug authority cancelled 16 licences and suspended eight, including a Pfizer depot, after a raid uncovered an unlicensed drug repacking operation in Bidadi with fake labels and machinery worth Rs 5.05 crore. The crackdown highlights gaps in pharma supply-chain oversight.

items.headline: Arunachal Pradesh steps up dengue surveillance as cases rise
items.summary: The state health department directed officials to strengthen surveillance, testing and preventive measures after a rise in dengue cases in the Itanagar capital region and nearby areas, as India's dengue season stretches increasingly beyond the traditional monsoon window.

items.headline: LeT terrorist linked to Pahalgam attack killed in J&K encounter
items.summary: Security forces killed Mohammad Asif alias Hashim Moosa, a Pakistan-trained Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist wanted for the April 2025 Pahalgam attack, in a joint Army-police-CRPF operation in Jammu and Kashmir's Budgam district. He had served in Pakistan's special forces before joining LeT.

items.headline: Central team reviews Himachal Pradesh disaster damage in six districts
items.summary: A seven-member inter-ministerial central team assessed losses from recent disasters across six Himachal Pradesh districts, as the state government seeks central assistance for relief and reconstruction. The review feeds into decisions on disaster relief funding for the hill state.

items.headline: Kerala government alleges CPI(M) link to attack on minister
items.summary: Kerala's government condemned an alleged attack on Sports Minister and Youth Congress leader OJ Janeesh in Kannur, claiming DYFI-CPI(M) workers carried it out with the party leadership's knowledge. The incident adds to friction between the ruling Left and opposition Congress ahead of state polls.

items.headline: Sensex sinks to 2026 low as rate fears, oil prices bite
items.summary: The Sensex crashed as much as 1,280 points intraday to a 2026 low of 71,293, with the Nifty touching the 22,200-22,300 band, as rate-hike worries, high crude prices and sustained foreign selling hit sentiment. Auto stocks fell up to 6% while IT held up better.

items.headline: Rupee under pressure near 96/dollar on oil, US yields
items.summary: The rupee opened near 95.95 per dollar and stayed under pressure as US Treasury yields hit a multi-decade high of 5.30% and oil prices stayed elevated. The RBI has reportedly been selling dollars to defend the psychologically important 96 level.

items.headline: MTNL stock jumps 17% on Rs 891 crore Mumbai land sale
items.summary: Shares of state-run telecom MTNL surged 17% after its board approved the sale of a Mumbai property for Rs 891.53 crore, giving the debt-laden company a much-needed cash infusion. The stock has been volatile on recurring asset-monetisation news.

items.headline: SBI buys nearly 40% of Reliance's $1.35 billion bond sale
items.summary: State Bank of India picked up close to 40% of a $1.35 billion debt sale by Reliance Industries, underscoring strong domestic appetite for top-rated corporate bonds even as equity markets wobbled. The deal highlights deepening ties between banks and large corporate borrowers.

items.headline: A-One Steels India shares jump 14% on stock-market debut
items.summary: A-One Steels India listed at a premium over its Rs 405 issue price, opening at Rs 455 on the NSE (up 12.35%) and Rs 462 on the BSE (up 14%), after the IPO was subscribed more than 12 times. The strong debut reflects continued retail appetite for smaller IPOs.

items.headline: Asian markets mixed, oil elevated as Iran war risk lingers
items.summary: Asian equities traded mixed and crude stayed elevated, with Brent near $98 a barrel, as investors weighed stalled Iran ceasefire talks and firmer US futures after soft inflation data. Indian equities were tipped to open lower, tracking the cautious regional mood.

items.headline: Wall Street edges higher as soft inflation data eases Fed bets
items.summary: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all closed modestly higher as cooler-than-expected PCE inflation data reduced worries about further Fed rate hikes, even as oil prices ticked up. Nvidia was among the stocks in focus during the session.

items.headline: Amazon doubles Amazon Now reach to 120+ Indian cities
items.summary: Amazon expanded its ultra-fast delivery service Amazon Now to more than 120 Indian cities in just two weeks, fulfilling orders through nearly 800 micro-fulfilment centres. The company is targeting 300 cities as it races to build India's largest delivery-in-minutes network.

items.headline: Pentagon data breach exposes personal records of 3 million people
items.summary: A breach at the Pentagon's Defense Manpower Data Center exposed names, Social Security numbers and service details of roughly 3 million current and former personnel, after unauthorised access to a file-sharing server went undetected for about nine months. No group has claimed responsibility.

items.headline: Apple patches iPhone zero-day exploited in targeted spyware attack
items.summary: Apple released iOS, iPadOS and macOS updates fixing a CoreGraphics zero-day, CVE-2026-86950, that was exploited in an "extremely sophisticated attack" on specific individuals. Meta's security team discovered and reported the flaw, which could allow arbitrary code execution via a crafted file.

items.headline: NASA-ISRO's NISAR satellite captures volcanic eruption in time-lapse
items.summary: The joint NASA-ISRO NISAR radar satellite captured a time-lapse video of an active volcanic eruption, using microwave pulses that make flowing lava appear distinctly brighter than surrounding terrain. The imagery showcases the satellite's ability to monitor hazards invisible to optical cameras.

items.headline: Global oceans report delivers 'starkest warning yet' on warming
items.summary: A Copernicus-backed oceans report found seas are absorbing record heat and warming at an accelerating pace, with ocean warming rates doubling over 20 years and sea levels rising faster than before. Scientists called it the clearest signal yet of an intensifying climate crisis.

items.headline: Drug shown to extend organisms' lifespan by up to 25%
items.summary: UK scientists reported that an experimental compound extended the lifespan of test organisms by as much as 25% in preclinical studies, adding to a wave of longevity research targeting cellular ageing pathways. Human trials remain a distant prospect, researchers cautioned.

items.headline: US measles cases surpass 1,700 as outbreak keeps growing
items.summary: The US measles count grew by 43 cases in a week to reach 1,714, with more than half the new cases in Utah and 92% of patients unvaccinated or of unknown status, underscoring persistent vaccine-hesitancy gaps even in a wealthy country.

items.headline: India thrash Sri Lanka to reach Asian Games cricket final
items.summary: India bowled out Sri Lanka for 45 after posting 169/7, winning by 124 runs to storm into the men's cricket gold-medal match against Pakistan. Ishan Kishan hit an unbeaten 80 while Jasprit Bumrah, Abhishek Sharma and Axar Patel took two wickets each.

items.headline: India's men win compound archery team gold at Asian Games
items.summary: Sahil Jadhav, Ganesh Mani Ratnam Thirumuru and Kushal Dalal won gold in the men's compound team archery final, edging China 238-237 in a tense finish at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya.

items.headline: India's women win compound archery team gold over China
items.summary: Jyothi Surekha Vennam, Prithika Pradeep and Chikitha Taniparthi won the women's compound team archery gold, beating China 238-234 in the final, adding to India's strong archery showing at the 2026 Asian Games.

items.headline: India's men's squash team reach Asian Games semis, assure medal
items.summary: India's men's squash team advanced to the semi-finals at the 2026 Asian Games, guaranteeing at least a bronze medal and keeping alive India's hopes of a stronger finish in a sport it has steadily grown in since its Asiad debut.

items.headline: Liverpool, Bayern, Chelsea win in Champions League action
items.summary: Liverpool beat Marseille 3-0, Bayern Munich downed Union SG 2-0 with a Harry Kane goal, and Chelsea edged Pafos 1-0 on a late Moises Caicedo strike, while Barcelona thrashed Slavia Prague 4-2 in a busy Champions League matchday.

items.headline: Djokovic wins Beijing opener as Khachanov upsets Auger-Aliassime
items.summary: Novak Djokovic beat Nuno Borges 6-3, 7-6 on his return to the ATP China Open in Beijing, while Karen Khachanov pulled off an upset over second seed Felix Auger-Aliassime, winning 6-3, 6-3 to reach the next round.

items.headline: F1 heads to Malaysia for rescheduled Bahrain Grand Prix
items.summary: Formula 1 moves to Sepang this weekend for a relocated Bahrain Grand Prix, originally cancelled in April due to the Iran war, with practice on Friday, qualifying Saturday and the race Sunday. It sits in a triple-header before Singapore on October 11.
